shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && echo ---- && ls -R .agents/skills/gravity-ui | head -50 && echo ---- && cat package.json && echo ---- && ls -la && cat AGENTS.md

ls -R src index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts __agent_eval__ && echo ---- && cat src/* index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts 2>/dev/null; echo ----; head -80 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; echo ----; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; echo ----; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/; echo ----; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/; echo ----; bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit TextInput Select Switch Checkbox Button Avatar Text Flex Box Card Label 2>&1 | head -80

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build && B=esm/components; for f in TextInput/TextInput.d.ts controls/types.d.ts Select/types.d.ts Switch/Switch.d.ts Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts Avatar/types/main.d.ts Button/Button.d.ts Text/Text.d.ts layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts layout/Box/Box.d.ts layout/types.d.ts Card/Card.d.ts Divider/Divider.d.ts; do echo "=== $f"; sed -n '1,200p' $B/$f 2>/dev/null | grep -vE '^\s*(\*|/\*\*|\*/)' | head -120; done 2>&1 | head -500; ls $B/Avatar $B/Select | head -40

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm && cat components/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts; echo "=== types"; grep -n -A12 'ControlProps\b' components/types.d.ts | head -60; grep -n -B2 -A8 'ControlGroupOption' components/types.d.ts | head -30; echo "=== avatar"; cat components/Avatar/types/common.d.ts components/Avatar/AvatarImage/types.d.ts components/Avatar/AvatarText/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null || ls components/Avatar/AvatarImage components/Avatar/AvatarText components/Avatar/types; echo "=== text"; cat components/Text/text/text.d.ts components/Text/colorText/colorText.d.ts | grep -vE '^\s*(\*|/\*\*|\*/)'; echo "=== hooks"; ls hooks | grep -i file; cat hooks/useFileInput/useFileInput.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo "=== index exports"; grep -n -iE 'useFileInput|FormRow|Label|Avatar' index.d.ts components/index.d.ts hooks/index.d.ts | head

cat components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts | grep -vE '^\s*(\*|/\*\*|\*/)'; grep -n 'useFileInput\|export \* from "./hooks' index.d.ts; grep -n -A3 'spacing' ../../../../../.agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/layout.md | head -40
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -8 && rm -rf dist && git status --short
